item.title: WATCH- 'Players became disrespectful, arrogant after beating India'- Yousuf on Pakistan cricket’s downfall; says Babar was why he resigned
item.description: Former Pakistan batter and coach Mohammad Yousuf has stated that Pakistan players became arrogant and disrespectful towards coaches and mentors after defeating India in the 2021 T20 World Cup. He cited this as the reason behind Pakistan cricket’s downfall since then. item.description: Zimbabwe registered a stunning six-wicket victory over Sri Lanka in their final Group B T20 World Cup 2026 clash at R.Premadasa Stadium, Colombo on Thursday (February 19).
